Subject: Q3 FY25 Goal Chartering: owners, line-items & QBR pack

Team —

Attached is a first-pass charter for Q3 FY25 (see attachment: Q3_goal_draft.xlsx). High level asks:

- Confirm owners for each line item (column F in the spreadsheet)
- Flag hard dependencies and compliance items that need early notice
- Add any missing success metrics (we should limit to 3 per objective)

Proposed timeline:
- Today: initial review and inline comments
- Wed EOD (18 Jun): owners locked and responsibilities spelled out
- Fri (20 Jun): final QBR slide deck draft to the leadership folder

I want to run a 30-min leadership kickoff on Thu 12 Jun at 10:00 PT to align milestones and make final owner decisions. Please reply with conflicts or accept.

Key notes for this quarter: we must prioritize reliability (latency P95), cost per inference, and developer DX (onboarding time). Expect we will route a condensed QBR pack to execs the week following sign-off.

Attachments: Q3_goal_draft.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 120KB)

Thanks —
Maya Srinivasan
VP, Product Operations
